aapl.text: Apple’s value fell 41.5% from Dec 2007 to Dec 2008, leaving £10,000 invested at the high worth £5,850 at the low.

azn.text: AstraZeneca had a bumpy ride, with annual volatility of 20.5% and a 41.0% fall from Aug 2006 to Mar 2008.

btc.text: Bitcoin had volatility of 72.5% a year and fell 74.2% from Dec 2017 to Jan 2019.

iglt.text: The UK government bond fund fell 31.9% from May 2020 to Oct 2023 and remained 25.9% below its high in Aug 2026.

msft.text: Microsoft shares fell 35.5% from Dec 2007 to Feb 2009, leaving £10,000 invested at the high worth £6,450 at the low.

nvda.text: Nvidia’s ride was bumpy, with annual volatility of 46.1%, and it fell 72.5% from Sep 2007 to Nov 2008.

sgln.text: The physical gold fund fell 38.2% from Aug 2011 to Jul 2015, but rose 7.5% from Jan 2020 to Mar 2020.
